script_text: Hold on—Aries, the cosmos will ignite your summer with a fierce planetary clash reshaping love and career. Monday’s Mars‑Jupiter trine in Aries fuels bold confidence, making it your most energized day for bold Fire‑sign initiatives. Tuesday’s Mercury‑Saturn square blocks communication, creating work tension and cautious talks, reminding your Fire heart to temper impulsiveness. Thursday’s Sun enters Cancer, opposing Mars and shifting focus from aggression to emotional depth and home matters, urging your Fire spirit to pause. Friday’s Uranus‑Pluto trine sparks unexpected financial gains and creative breakthroughs. Saturday’s Mars‑Moon square adds volatile romance stress, while Sunday’s Mercury‑Jupiter sextile restores optimism. Wednesday shines as Venus enters your 5th House, igniting romance and creative spark. Tuesday drags with Mercury‑Saturn square straining communication and work pressure. Schedule talks before Tuesday’s square or grab Friday’s Uranus‑Pluto trine for that surprise money win. Follow for daily updates.
